LESSON: MEASURING AND MARKING OUT TOOLS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Tools and Production
Topic 4.1: Measuring and Marking Out Tools
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 18

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Measuring and Marking Out Tools, part of Tools and Production in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why are measuring and marking out tools important in day-to-day life? • How are measuring and marking out tools used when performing tasks?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Measuring and Marking Out Tools together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem-solving: the learner develops explanation, evaluation and decision-making skills when

choosing the appropriate measuring and marking out tools to perform a given task.

• Self-efficacy: learner develops self-awareness skills by showing a concerted attention to detail when performing specific

tasks using measuring and marking out tools.

Values:
• Respect: learner shows open-mindedness when discussing the use of measuring and marking out tools in the work

environment.

• Responsibility: learner shows accountability by caring for and maintaining measuring and marking out tools in the work

environment.

29

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Disaster risk reduction: Learner avoids situations that can lead to injuries when caring for and maintaining measuring and

marking out tools in the work environment.

● Internet safety and security: learner portrays responsible online behaviour when using a digital device to watch video clips

showing the use of measuring and marking out tools to perform specific tasks.

Link to Other Subjects:

• Mathematics as the learner carries out geometric construction.

• Integrated Science as the learner identifies laboratory tools and equipment

Suggested Learning Resources:

Pre-technical Studies curriculum design, Pre-technical Studies handbook, Volunteer resource person, realia, pictures, charts
